title: Isabella Bank Launches Second Annual “Holiday with Heart” Initiative to Donate $25,000 to Local Nonprofits
summary: Isabella Bank is spreading holiday cheer through the second annual Holiday with Heart initiative, which will distribute a total of $25,000 to nonprofit organizations across the communities it serves.
body_markdown:
MOUNT PLEASANT, Mich., Nov. 16, 2026– Isabella Bank is spreading holiday cheer through the second annual Holiday with Heart initiative, which will distribute a total of $25,000 to nonprofit organizations across the communities it serves. The initiative reflects the Bank's ongoing commitment to strengthening local communities and supporting organizations that make a meaningful difference.


Holiday with Heart brings employees and community members together in the spirit of giving. Isabella Bank employees began the process by nominating nonprofit organizations that inspire them through their impact and service. This year, the initiative expanded to include organizations across Isabella Bank's growing footprint, including Kent County. From those nominations, nine finalists were selected to receive funding that will help advance their missions:


- Listening Ear Crisis Center


-


Big R’s and Smokin’ Joe’s Hospice
- Ten16 Recovery Network
- READ Association of Saginaw County
- Rescue Ministries of Mid-Michigan
- Sleep in Heavenly Peace- Gratiot County Chapter
- Our Brother’s Keeper of Mecosta County
- EightCap
- Ele’s Place West Michigan


Each organization will receive a donation based on community voting results:


- Grand Gift: $10,000


-


Impact Leader: $5,000
- Difference Makers: $2,500 each (two recipients)
- Community Champions: $1,000 each (five recipients)


Community voting will be open from November 23 through December 7 at[isabellabank.com/holidaywithheart](https://www.isabellabank.com/holiday-with-heart) . Community members are also encouraged to follow Isabella Bank on Facebook throughout the voting period for spotlights highlighting the important work and missions of each finalist organization.


"At Isabella Bank, we believe strong communities are built by people and organizations who show up for others every day," said Neil McDonnell, President of Isabella Bank. "We're proud to support the nonprofits making a meaningful difference across our footprint and grateful to give our communities a voice in how these funds are distributed. We can't wait to see how this support helps advance their missions and further their impact throughout the holiday season and beyond."


For more information and to cast your vote, visit[isabellabank.com/holidaywithheart](https://www.isabellabank.com/holiday-with-heart) .
